description: Remove a person from the workspace entirely, along with every audience membership. Their suppression and topic preferences are kept on purpose — an opt-out has to outlive the contact record, or the next import silently puts them back on the list. remove_from_audience takes someone off a single audience instead.

contact_id.description: The contact's id (a UUID) from find_contact, add_contact or get_contact — not the email address. find_contact returns the id for an address.

name: delete_contact
